newsitem.title: USA: Florida Development buys I-95 site.
newsitem.headline: Florida Development buys I-95 site.

text.p: Florida Development Fund (1995) Inc said it bought an I-95 interchange parcel and hopes to develop the site into an upscale hotel.
The 15.4-acre site at State Road 714 and I-95 was purchased on September 3.
Florida Development said it simultaneously sold about one-tenth of the site to an affiliate of a major oil company for about $550,000.

Development plans for the remaining parcel will featue an upscale hotel, three outparcels and a conference center with a limited amount of office space for a total buildout value of about $10 million, it said.
